correctness.rationale: The standalone deterministic finite verifier enumerates all path facets and subfaces, checks directed matching acyclicity by topological sort over 10,212 faces and 58,830 incidences, computes exact signed integer zero Morse differential 4x24, and independently checks mod-two boundary ranks. The zero attaching degrees in a 4-connected five-skeleton imply nullhomotopic attaching maps by Hurewicz, yielding the exact wedge. A separate all-32768-mask census proves the sharp linear-forest obstructions.

value.rationale: The homotopy type is a natural invariant of how partial edge constraints extend to spanning Hamiltonian paths on the canonical hypohamiltonian Petersen graph. The pure eight-dimensional complex unexpectedly reduces to a mixed wedge in dimensions five and six; its 10+30 sharp minimal extension obstructions form two natural symmetry orbits. These facts are not a simple rephrasing of known Hamiltonian-path counts.
